description_ru: Марко боится признаться начальнице, что сломал принтер, а коллега Прия помогает ему найти поломку и набраться смелости.
text:
Marco: Priya, have you got a minute? I need to tell you something, and you must promise not to laugh.
Priya: That is the worst way to start a conversation. What did you do?
Marco: I think I broke the printer.
Priya: The big printer on the second floor? The one Ms. Quinn bought last month?
Marco: That one. I was printing the report for the meeting, and the paper got stuck. So I opened the little door at the back and pulled it. Something went crack. Now the screen only says "Error 47".
Priya: Marco! What did you pull?
Marco: I don't know. A grey plastic thing. It's in my pocket.
Priya: It's in your pocket? You took a piece out of the machine?

Marco: It came off in my hand! I didn't plan it. Please don't tell Ms. Quinn. She's already angry with me about the coffee cups.
Priya: What happened with the coffee cups?
Marco: Nothing important. I left twelve of them on my desk for a week. Two of them had little green forests inside.
Priya: That's disgusting. Okay, listen. If we tell her now, it's a small problem. If she finds out later, it's a big one.
Marco: But if I tell her now, she'll look at me like this. You know, with the eyebrow.
Priya: The eyebrow is scary. I agree.
Marco: So, what do we do?
Priya: First, let me look at the machine. Maybe we can put the piece back.

Priya: Hold the door. Show me the grey thing.
Marco: Here. It's quite small, isn't it?
Priya: It has a little arrow on it. I think it goes in this slot. Hmm. It doesn't fit.
Marco: Try the other way.
Priya: It still doesn't fit! Marco, did you put something else in here? There's a coin inside.
Marco: A coin? Oh. That's my lunch money. I dropped it on Tuesday.
Priya: Your lunch money is stopping the printer, and you came to me about the grey plastic thing?
Marco: I forgot! I'm sorry! I only remembered when you said "coin".
Priya: Give me that pen. I can pull it out.

Marco: Careful, careful. Don't break anything else.
Priya: I won't. I've got it. Look, it's two pounds. You lost two pounds and broke a printer in one week.
Marco: It's been a very bad week. Now try the grey piece.
Priya: Right. Arrow up. And... click. There! Now close the door.
Marco: Please work, please work, please work.
Priya: Press the green button.
Marco: The screen says "Ready". Priya, it says "Ready"! You're a genius!
Priya: I know. But you owe me lunch for a month.
Marco: A month? That's very expensive!
Priya: So is a new printer.

Ms. Quinn: Good morning, everyone. Why are you standing around the printer like two guilty cats?
Marco: Good morning, Ms. Quinn. We're not guilty. We're just... admiring it.
Ms. Quinn: Admiring a printer?
Priya: It's a very nice printer.
Ms. Quinn: I see. Marco, I need twenty copies of the report in five minutes. Is that possible?
Marco: Of course. No problem at all.
Ms. Quinn: Good. And please throw away the cups on your desk. Somebody told me one of them is growing.
Marco: I'll do it right away.

Priya: Marco, tell her.
Marco: Tell her what?
Priya: That you broke the printer. We've just fixed it, and she's going to find out.
Marco: How can she find out? It works now.
Priya: Because the paper might get stuck again, and she'll see the grey piece is a bit crooked.
Marco: Hmm. You're right. Okay, I'll tell her.

Marco: Ms. Quinn, can I speak to you for a moment?
Ms. Quinn: Yes. What is it? You look like you're going to the dentist.
Marco: I want to say sorry. This morning the paper got stuck in the printer, and I pulled it too hard. A part came off.
Ms. Quinn: Is the printer working now?
Marco: Yes. Priya helped me fix it. I also found two pounds inside the machine. I'll put it in the coffee fund.
Ms. Quinn: So you broke the printer, you lost your lunch money, and you fixed it with help?
Marco: That's a good summary.

Ms. Quinn: Thank you for telling me. I'm not angry. Do you know how many people have broken that printer?
Marco: No. How many?
Ms. Quinn: Six. In one month. Even me.
Priya: You broke it too?
Ms. Quinn: On the first day. I pressed every button, because I was in a hurry. It made a noise like a sad cow.
Marco: So we're all printer criminals.
Ms. Quinn: Welcome to the club. Next time, read the sign on the back door. It says "Do not pull".
Marco: There's a sign?
Priya: It's in red, Marco.
Ms. Quinn: In very big letters. Nobody ever sees it.

Ms. Quinn: Now, go and print my twenty copies. And Marco, wash the cups before lunch.
Marco: Yes, Ms. Quinn.
Priya: And Marco?
Marco: Yes?
Priya: Don't forget. You owe me lunch.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Короткий звук между «а» и «э», рот полуоткрыт; не произносите «о».
Начните с округлённого «о» и плавно перейдите в «и»; звук слитный.
Начните с «а» и плавно перейдите в «и»; не разделяйте на два звука.
Короткий звук между «и» и «ы»; не растягивайте его как «ии».

questions.question: What does Marco think he has broken?
questions.answer: The printer on the second floor.

questions.question: What was really stopping the printer?
questions.answer: A coin, his lunch money, inside the machine.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Quinn not angry?
questions.answer: Because many people, even she, have broken the printer.
